name: DSBench
why_it_matters: Data journalists routinely need agents that can ingest messy datasets, run analyses, and summarize findings accurately — exactly what DSBench evaluates end-to-end.
task_shape: Agents are given realistic data science tasks from Kaggle and ModelOff (spreadsheets, CSVs, task descriptions) and must load data, reason, run code, and produce answers or narrative summaries judged against ground truth.
signals: Tasks are sourced from real Kaggle competitions and analytics challenges, giving a realistic proxy for newsroom data work.
Current frontier agents solve only a minority of tasks, so scores can be noisy indicators for lightweight journalism use cases.
